packages.name: nodejs
packages.why: npm, which the bats entries install with (win-prereqs.json:`"manager": "npm"`), comes with Node.js.

packages.name: uv
packages.why: The pre-commit and linode-cli entries install as uv tools (win-prereqs.json:`"manager": "uv"`).

packages.name: python3
packages.why: The prose-wrap hook runs python3 (.pre-commit-config.yaml:`entry: python3 tests/lint/prose_wrap.py`); the python3 link step points python3 at the newest Python this installs.

packages.name: bats
packages.why: The test gate runs bats under Git Bash (.github/workflows/tests.yml:`run: bats tests/shell/test_*.bats`).

packages.name: bats-support
packages.why: tests/helpers/common.bash:`bats_load_library bats-support` loads it from BATS_LIB_PATH (npm root -g).

packages.name: bats-assert
packages.why: tests/helpers/common.bash:`bats_load_library bats-assert` loads it from BATS_LIB_PATH (npm root -g).

packages.name: bats-file
packages.why: tests/helpers/common.bash:`bats_load_library bats-file` loads it. The npm registry's bats-file is a security placeholder, so it comes from the project's repository.

packages.name: pytest
packages.why: The python job runs pytest tests/python (.github/workflows/tests.yml:`pytest tests/python`), importable by python3.

packages.name: pre-commit
packages.why: The check config runs as pre-commit run --all-files (.github/workflows/tests.yml:`pre-commit run --all-files`) and on every commit.

packages.name: Pester
packages.why: The PowerShell tests need Pester 5 or later (tests/powershell/Install-Prereqs.Tests.ps1:`ModuleVersion = '5.0'`), beside the in-box 3.4.

packages.name: docker-desktop
packages.why: The docker_image pre-commit hooks (.pre-commit-config.yaml:`language: docker_image`) and bin/docker_wrapper (bin/docker_wrapper:`exec docker run`) run docker.
packages.slow: about 1 GB to download; this can take 20+ minutes
